source_defects.description: No point allocations, grading rubric, score, or credit instructions are printed. The benchmark uses an explicit curator normalization of 25 points per full problem and derived criterion weights.

The intermediate component statement writes N/cos(alpha)=m v^2/(r0 sin(alpha)) while describing a horizontal component; that wording/equation is inconsistent. The final N=(m v^2/r0)cot(alpha) is correct from the cone-normal acceleration.
The finite-difference radial balance as printed has a sign inconsistent with its following correct result dP/dr=rho0 v^2/r. The final pressure deficit is correct.
B1(d)(ii)(ii) asks for behavior 'as as r -> 0'; the duplicated word has no mathematical effect.

source_defects.description: The solution equates the physical velocity deflection with 2 arccos(1/e), its supplement, and treats the orbit-dependent semilatus rectum r0 as common across a fixed-energy impact-parameter family. Correctly, B=a_C cot(alpha_s/2), and part (b)'s e=3 gives a_C=r0/8, hence B=(r0/8)cot(alpha_s/2).
B3(c) says 'part (1)' although the problem is lettered; it refers to the Q=omega L/R result in part (a).
